verdict.rationale: Granola Chat lets users query all meetings, a single meeting, or a folder in natural language. It can also carry out post-meeting actions on request: drafting and sending follow-up emails and Slack messages, and scheduling Google Calendar events, each with a review step before anything goes out. Saved prompts can be rerun as recipes, and the MCP server lets external assistants like Claude and ChatGPT query notes in natural language. Missing for 10: no evidence that core app operations (starting or stopping recording, managing folders, sharing, settings) can be driven by natural-language commands, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat workflows.
